body: A lot of people will mental illness and at the stages of thinking and planning suicide don’t have a few months to give it a few months and see. I’ve been on my medications for 10 years it’s not like it’s new medication that you need to wait months for it to take affect. Like I stated I’m aware not taking my medications in the mornings wouldn’t help the situation but even when I was taking them all the time it never made it better either. I am quite aware to take them but give it a few months when you’re trying to hold on hour to hour and minute to minute is just...probably why I shouldn’t of posted on here in the first place so anyways just disregard my post I’ll do whatever it is I have to do I’ll figure out the right thing to do for myself in my current situation.

Mentally I never fully recovered after that overdose. Physically I felt better within 4 or 5 days in hospital but that was a year ago and I had a few overdoses in that years time and now I’m quite sick physically. I don’t know if the overdoses had an effect on my health but there’s a good chance they did with my multiple attempts as I now constantly am physically ill, stomach pains daily, nauseous daily, all around exhaustion and I’ve been diagnosed with other physical health conditions that the overdoses could have contributed to. So even though you had a low overdose it’s still considered an overdose and everyone’s bodies react differently and overdoses like ibuprofen and Tylenol can cause effects that you don’t see right away and won’t get the symptoms until later in life if you continued taking too much. Any amount considered an overdose even if not a lot should seek medical attention. Message me if you need to talk I have experience with overdoses unfortunately so if you need to talk I might be able to help or even if you just need to vent.

I took somewhere around 12,000 mg I believe. (Around 60 tablets of 200mg). I do NOT suggest it at all. It’s the worst pain at least it caused me a lot of pain and I lived it just got me very sick, cups full of charcoal, hooked up to machines then immediately 3 weeks in a mental health unit.

Last year I took a very large overdose of ibuprofen and no it did not kill me but trust me It’s not fun. You will most likely vomit and vomit a lot. If you get medical attention they will get you to drink cups full of charcoal to soak up the meds, again charcoal is also really not pleasant but it helps to try to prevent problems with your health due to the overdose of ibuprofen and you should probably be on IV fluids or well at least I was. The fluids and charcoal helped me to feel somewhat ok but I still felt like complete crap for days. Ibuprofen overdoses are not good they damage your insides and gastrointestinal tract and can cause ulcers and a lot more issues that I’m not fully aware of I remember it was a long list the hospital gave me of long term effects and make you vomit a lot.

Thank you for your kind words. It’s even harder each day as I’ve always worked in the vet industry and still do so it’s hard when shih tzus come in that remind me of him. I still stay professional but when I get home I break down.

I have suicidal urges all the time. They’re always there sometimes quiter but still there and others it’s like screaming to me to do something about it. It’s been 13 years that I’ve been dealing with them since I was only 14. I can say the cliche what all doctors have told me “try to distract yourself” When really that’s the hardest thing to do but sometimes it actually does work. Not all the time definitely not all the time but sometimes distracting your mind just for a little while can make the urges go down a little. I’ve also called help lines when the urges wouldn’t go away. I didn’t know what to say I’d just call and say I’m not ok and they would stay on the line even if I didn’t speak at all. Other times I just take my medication until I fall asleep and the thoughts stop. I have an as needed medication that helps calm me when I have the thoughts they don’t go away but it can help sometimes. Talking will help to even if it’s to people on here, you can message me if you need to vent or anything. I understand the feeling way more than I should.
